response: ["The licensed guideline corpus contains no recommendation for 'NEV'.","Formal dermatology guidelines focus on malignant and pre‑malignant lesions.","The absence of a recommendation for 'NEV' is due to a coverage boundary of the corpus, not a retrieval failure.","The 7‑point checklist score triggers a melanoma suspicion threshold.","The router bound the case to the MEL condition group because of the melanoma suspicion threshold.","Surgical excision with histologically negative margins is the recommended and first‑line treatment for primary cutaneous melanoma of any thickness and for melanoma in situ (PMID 30392755 table X).","Surgical margins should be based on tumor thickness (PMID 30392755 table X).","Sentinel lymph node biopsy, when indicated, should be performed before wide excision of the primary tumor and in the same operative setting whenever possible (PMID 30392755 table X).","When melanoma is suspected, the whole lesion should be completely excised with a narrow (1‑3 mm) margin to perform histological diagnosis (PMID 39709737 recommendation 1).","Incisional biopsies can be performed on large lesions such as lesions on the face (e.g., lentigo maligna), acral lesions, and on the genitalia (PMID 39709737 recommendation 1).","The consensus rate for recommendation 1 is 100% (21/21).","The criteria driving the 7‑point score are pigment_network (atypical, 2 points) and dots_and_globules (irregular, 1 point)."]
